definitions.explanation: A personal thought or judgment about something.
A recommendation or counsel given to someone.

⟦みんな→みんな：02972_minna⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{意見|いけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}こう→聞く：00483_kiku⟧。
⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{意見|いけん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦それ→それ：00994_sore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}います→思う：00492_omou⟧。

examples.english: I rewrote the report based on my senior's advice.

notes:
{意見|いけん} means 'opinion' or 'view.'

Common collocations:
- {意見|いけん}を{言|い}う/{述|の}べる: to state an opinion
- {意見|いけん}を{聞|き}く: to listen to/ask for opinions
- {意見|いけん}が{合|あ}う/{一致|いっち}する: to agree (opinions match)
- {意見|いけん}が{違|ちが}う/{分|わ}かれる: to disagree
- {意見|いけん}を{交換|こうかん}する: to exchange opinions

Similar words:
- {意見|いけん} vs. {考|かんが}え: {意見|いけん} is more formal/official; {考|かんが}え is more casual/personal thinking
- {意見|いけん} vs. {感想|かんそう}: {感想|かんそう} is impression/feeling; {意見|いけん} is thought/judgment
